package calc

import "fmt"

// Base is the radix Render uses. CODETRAILDOC marks this as doc prose.
const Base = 10

// Add and Sub name the operations Machine understands. CODETRAILDOC.
var (
	Add = "add"
	Sub = "sub"
)

// Machine accumulates a running total. CODETRAILDOC.
type Machine struct {
	total int
}

// Push adds n to the running total and returns it. CODETRAILDOC.
func (m *Machine) Push(n int) int {
	m.total += n
	return m.total
}

// Render formats the total in Base. CODETRAILDOC.
func Render(m *Machine) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d (base %d)", m.total, Base)
}
